info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Events Ticketing Tickets Validates-v2-spec
info.description: The Event Ticket Validation API enables users to verify the validity of tickets for various events. This endpoint allows consumers to check the status of a ticket and ensure it can be used for entry. Typical users include event organizers, ticket sellers, and customer support teams who need to confirm a ticket's authenticity before an event. By using this endpoint, stakeholders can enhance the overall event experience and minimize fraud.

get.description: This endpoint is responsible for validating the details of a ticket. It checks if the ticket is valid and provides the necessary response based on the validation status.
